name: The Last Resort
description: The Last Resort grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Pumpkins, and Eggplant in Monkton, VT. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
